goodpas.service_conflict_tips: When GoodPAS is enabled, functions such as {feature} cannot be used.
goodpas.primary_intro_title: Your router can work as the Main Node.
goodpas.secondary_intro_title: Your router can work as the Client.
goodpas.primary_intro_tips: Keep this router online as your Main Node. Create an access code to use with a travel router or the GoodPAS app, allowing secure access to devices on this network and browsing the Internet via its public IP address.
goodpas.secondary_intro_tips: Connect this router to your home router or GoodPAS Dongle using an access code. Access devices on the Main Node’s network and browse through its Internet connection.
goodpas.need_login_cloud_tips: Please login to the Cloud Sevice to complete the binding to continue using GoodPAS service.
goodpas.connect_guide_title: How to Connect to This Main Node
goodpas.guide_step_two: 2. Enter an access code generated below.
goodpas.router_guide_tips:
1. Open GoodPAS on your travel router.
2. Enter an access code generated by this Main Node.
goodpas.app_guide_tips:
1. Open the GoodPAS App and add a Main Node.
2. Enter an access code or scan its QR code.
goodpas.reset_primary_tips:
Once the home router is reset, the connected clients will be removed and revert to accessing the Internet through their local network.

Are you sure you want to proceed?
goodpas.reset_secondary_tips:
All current configurations will be erased, and your secure link will be lost. This action cannot be undone.

Are you sure you want to reset?
goodpas.access_code_verify_failed_tips: Verification failed. Make sure you enter the correct access code.
goodpas.wifi_fetch_failed_tips: Unable to retrieve Wi-Fi settings. Please close this window and try again.
goodpas.access_code_tips:
Enter an access code generated by your home router or GoodPAS Dongle.
After verification, this router and its connected devices can access the Main Node’s network.
goodpas.pending_tips: Connection interrupted. Check your main node’s power and network, or disconnect to use your local network.
goodpas.revoked_tips: The Main Node has removed this Client. Enter a new access code to connect again.
goodpas.kicked_out_tips: Please enter new access code to connect.
goodpas.disconnect_tips: Disconnect from the Main Node and return to your local Internet connection?
goodpas.visible_on_lan_enabled_tips: When enabled, local devices can connect directly, and all other internet traffic still goes through the secure tunnel. You may not able to connect to the local network on the side of the PAS device.
goodpas.local_direct_tips: When disabled, your devices is hidden from other devices on your local network. Local connections like CarPlay, screen sharing and smart home gadgets may not work. All internet traffic goes through the secure tunnel. You can connect to the local network on the side of the PAS device.
goodpas.local_hidden_tips: When enabled, your device is hidden from other devices on the local network. Local connections like CarPlay, screen sharing, hotspots, and smart home gadgets may not work. All internet traffic still goes through the secure tunnel.
goodpas.local_connection_tips: Disconnected from the main node. This router and its connected devices are now using the local Internet connection.
goodpas.global_proxy_tips: Forward all traffic, including private network destinations, through the Main Node.
goodpas.bypass_lan_tips: Access local private networks directly and forward Internet traffic through the Main Node.
goodpas.invite_tips: Invite a Client with an access code. Each code can be used by one Client.
goodpas.no_clients_tips: Generate an access code to invite your first Client.
goodpas.total_limit_tips: The maximum number of Client invitations is 250.
goodpas.expired_retention_tips: Showing the latest 5 expired codes from the past 7 days.
goodpas.remove_client_tips: Are you sure you want to terminate the connection with this client?
goodpas.speed_test_tips: Test the connection speed between this Client and the Main Node.
goodpas.speed_test_failed_msg: The link speed test failed. Please try again.
goodpas.wireless_sync_tips: Get the Main Node's Wi-Fi settings and choose the networks to sync to this router.
goodpas.wireless_unavailable_tips: Available when connected to a router Main Node.
goodpas.wireless_unsupported_tips: Only available when connected to a home router that supports sync wireless settings.
goodpas.wifi_empty_tips: No Wi-Fi networks are available to sync.
goodpas.wifi_sync_warning_tips: Syncing changes the selected Wi-Fi settings on this router. Your wireless devices may disconnect.
goodpas.wifi_synced_tips: Refresh the Wi-Fi SSID and password from your home router to reconfigure your travel router.
goodpas.primary_expired_retention_tips: Showing the latest 5 expired codes from the past 7 days.
goodpas.share_invitation_tips:
Invite you to join the {name} network.

#Access Code: {code}
(expires in {minutes} mins)

Copy this message and paste it into travel router or the GoodPAS App to establish a connection with one tap.

Click the link below to download the GoodPAS App
https://www.gl-inet.com/pages/app-pas
goodpas.primary_invitation_empty_tips:
Connect a travel router or the GoodPAS APP
with an access code.
goodpas.primary_invite_tips: Generate an access code to invite a Client.
goodpas.speed_link_tips: This tests the connection speed within the GoodPAS link, not the actual Internet speed.
goodpas.speed_initial_unavailable_tips: Connect to the Main Node before running a link speed test.
goodpas.speed_unavailable_tips: Connect to the main node before running a link speed test.
goodpas.wireless_credentials_tips: Get Wi-Fi names and passwords from your {router} (GoodPAS Main Node), then choose which networks to sync to the current router.
goodpas.wifi_selection_tips: Select one or more Wi-Fi networks from your home router to sync their settings to your travel router.
